# A book whose top-level accounts are held in two currencies, CAD and USD, and
# that states no `base_currency:`.
#
# Nothing says which currency the book is kept in, so a report on it is
# refused rather than taken to be in CAD (Q-042).
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets in CAD and Liabilities in USD, and no
# `company` block.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_currency_a_book_is_kept_in.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
